decision.primary_special: Independent quill-legal natural starts: positive paired common-survivor log T10-to-T12 growth lower 95% bound, increased repeated verified rider activations across two turns, report T9-T15 reach separately.
decision.promotion: Also require natural paired terminal utility lower 95% bound above -0.05, T12 reach lower bound above -3 percentage points and no clear old-family regression. Report point estimates and paired intervals even if inconclusive.
decision.development_selection: Choose the best actual trained endpoint by mean original rank utility + 0.45 times mean clipped log1p(T10..T13 strength)/8, dead turns zero. Parent is reference, eligible students are BC and two-generation outcome-optimized BC. No final data used for selection.
